description: Section colour styling. Kissflow persists only NON-DEFAULT values — an empty Style node means "unstyled", never "unsupported". Colours on a FORM section are design-token refs, never hex.
notes: Only these two token names are CONFIRMED live: Color.Info.300, Color.Secondary.Ten.800. Every other token is UNCAPTURED — never probe or guess one; the write API does not validate them (a bogus token PUTs 200 and publishes clean, then fails SILENTLY at render). Capture a new token only by setting it in the builder's own colour dropdown first.
Setting a property's value to None/absent (not writing the key at all) is the only route back to the theme default — there is no explicit "unset" sentinel.
Reuse an existing Appearance/Style pair rather than creating a second one for the same section — Kissflow expects exactly one of each per styled node.

This is the FORM-section token-ref styling surface. App PAGES use a structurally different surface (raw hex/px-ish CSS values on Container/Component Style, see page_style.json) — do not conflate the two; they are different subsystems with different value formats.
